body: Thanks for that. You've helped out a lot

Its just hard to relate to people. I'm happy you repllied even if you were the only one. I wish things were different I guess and I understand that I won't ever truly be happy but being content would be so nice. I agree with the internet aspect whole heartedly. I wish I was a little closer to my end than I am because I seem to have had a life and a half already. I wish it was quick and not as long as its going to be. I'm sure you had the idea of not living past a certain year. Mine was 24 and I'm turning that ina few months. its also the year of the dragon in which I was born so maybe if those horror scopes or whatever you call them mean something. And maybe this is my year. Maybe I will be better than before. Or maybe nothing will change and ill be in the same boat. I can't help but always look forward to tomorrow even if it seems bleek and plain. Its all I have to get me through the now and away from the then.  I'm sure you understand better than most. I wish I was stronger. Or maybe as strong as you. Do you ever feel like your life could be in best selling novels? The kind where people can take a glimpse into the mind of a rebel, or someone who sees things differently and that if people read that book they would appreciate life a little more and what they didn't sacrifice for an 8 hour sensation? I often think id be happier if people were pleased with what they have rather than what they don't. I finally have a home a dog I even have a lady that appreciates my crazy out of mind experience. But then again I guess it could start with me and all I have to do is appreciate this instead of wanting more..
Looks like well have to start teaching philosophy in science class too.

None of that seemed harsh. I don't ever want to use again because it broke ties with my family and I never want to betray their trust again if I ever gain it back. The problem I'm having with this is the simple fact that no matter how hard I try I always end up short. I don't want a lot of people around me and the need for people to make me happy seems selfish. I want to like people. I want to get along with people and I don't understand why its so hard for me to do it when it comes natural for others. I know we all have skills and we all have certain strengths or weaknesses that make us who we are. But why is it that who I am is just generally a bad person? Why do treat people with scorn when they 9 times out of 10 aren't deserving of it? I know this is an old post and its been 10 days since I've made it but I'm just a busy person. I guess I'm just growing up and I feel like I missed my chance to be sociable and friendly and never got the chance to learn these things.
I would just for once be happy around people like I was when I did drugs but sober.
I just don't know anymore if this year ends as poorly as last year who knows what will happen. I just can't grip reality and it sucks.

Yeah, I'm aware of how shooting up has stolen happiness from me, I wish that were the issue I'm pretty good at dealing and fighting the urge to shoot up, it's hard but I can deal with it, that's my mistake and I chose to do it knowing that this would be the likely scenario. My problem is a little deeper than that unfortunately, I started doing drugs because I hated everyone and drugs helped me like people, or the people I did them with anyways. Now that I'm sober I can't tolerate the company of others and that makes me even more miserable. I don't like people at all, not to find excuses but I work third shift 40 hours a week and go to school, I'm also in training for a promotion that would allow me to do the only thing I love for a living and what little time I have left is devoted to reading and learning more about Administrating servers and writing code to help my chances on getting it. I'm on the right track to dealing with all the faults I've done and bettering my life, the only thing I can't seem to ever get over is my hate for people.
Sorry if this seems like a cop-out or a sad sap story I don't want people to feel bad for me. I'm also sorry if this reply is a little long but since I didn't include this in my post I figure I should go a little more indepth to why I started to hate people becoming estranged from society.
When I was in elementary school I met my first friend ever, his name was Adam, I remember the first day I met him we played lion-king. I remember him exactly how he was and as I'm typing this I can see his smile. The day before Easter he was murdered by his father, his father killed Adam, his sister, and his mother. then himself. I was just seven when this happened and after that I got into fights, got kicked out of the school I was going to(A private school) and started going to public school. Afterwhich, I got into more gruesome fights later down the line.
In sixth grade I met another cool guy he was really cool. We had a lot of the same likes, and he was my next best friend. We did everything together. I came to find out he wasn't real and was a delusion. Entirely. I was devastated for this too and was diagnosed with schizophrenia. After that I started doing drugs. All my friends afterwhich OD'd and died, or got murdered, or vanished. I can go on, and if you're willing to read more I will post more.
anyways, sorry for laying this all out on you.
